entry_points.text: Flagless vector takes fd, vector, length and offset; flagged adds behavior word; all-ones uses current position.
Sendfile and copy-range move between descriptors; tee, splice and vmsplice choose direction by mode.
Native and compat listings take fd, buffer and capacity, iterate, finalize position and report bytes.
Select and pselect import masks and timeouts; poll treats negative as unbounded else deadlines with restart.
Signalfd validates mask and delegates to creation; timer files validate clock, program, query and handle change.
Stat and statx resolve names, links or descriptors via VFS then convert; statfs fetches then renders.
Sync offers whole-system, full, data-only and range flush via shared helpers after validation.

exports.text: Direct splice and tee move bytes between files or pipes, rejecting bad modes and publishing new positions.
Copy range validates, clamps, prefers offload then remap then splice, notifies and accounts length.
Central select clamps count, uses stack or dynamic bitmaps and exports ready sets with distinct outcomes.
Seq file supports positioned reads plus buffered append, path rendering and normalized hex dumps.
Signalfd creation validates flags, excludes uncatchable signals, stores inverted mask and wakes waiters.
VFS stat and statx resolve by fd or path, validate mask and sync mode, strip kernel bits and format.
Super lookup by device returns lockable match with extra reference; statfs checks hooks then fills flags.
System sync flushes inodes then filesystems then block devices with repeating background passes.
Sysfs creates groups, links and attributes with visibility checks and rollback, plus formatting and notify.
Block superblocks mount by device with quiet option and tear down with sync before holder release.

hazards.text: Missing readers yield pipe signal plus error; missing writers end input quietly; nonblock retries, signals restart.
Listing and stat risk user faults, narrowed ids, position overflow and malformed inputs mapping to errors.
Reject negative timeout parts early; guard bitmap sizing; map zero-ready with signals to restartable interrupt.
Statfs fails with overflow on narrowed counts except all-ones unknown; super teardown defers freeing to workqueue.
Async emergency work does nothing when allocation fails; mount placeholders report collisions; resume defers to work.

invariants.text: Sendfile needs readable source and writable dest, resolves position, enforces ceilings, then accounts and advances.
Directory traversal needs live directory plus permission, carries position and checks bounded clean names.
Poll pins files with keys, ignores unmatched wakes and sleeps only if untriggered; select validates timeouts.
General splice validates modes, rejects pipe offsets and self or append cases, checks ranges and updates.
Stat converters zero output, enforce narrow limits, munge ids and copy times; readlink retries stale handles.
Byte accounting uses 512-byte units with carry; reclaim avoids locks until born; retire needs exclusive lock.
Inode and filesystem sync skip read-only; range sync validates flags; sysfs reads truncate and clip to hooks.
Signalfd reads move whole 128-byte records, blocking only first wait; timerfd clamps remaining, checks privilege.

locks.text: Pipe splice holds pipe mutex across wait and move; dual-pipe transfers order locks by address.
Directory traversal uses killable shared ownership, skipping immutable locks.
Poll wake marks trigger under queue sync; sleeper uses barrier; select samples max fd under RCU.
Signalfd poll and mask update hold sighand spin; superblock list uses dedicated spin with lifetime locks.
Sysfs owner clearing uses spinlock; timerfd ticks and cancel membership use queue and per-file locks.

state_machines.text: Direct engine needs seekable source and empty pipe, cycles intake and consume, ends on terminal empty and resets.
Select repeats scan and sleep, accumulates readiness and exits on ready, expiry, signal or memory failure.
Packed emitters consume aligned size, refuse bad names and narrowed ids, stop when full and patch position.
Pipe-to-pipe moves whole buffers or shares prefix, retrying on race; reclaim splits scans and prunes in order.
Timers move among disarmed, armed, expired and cancelled with rearm; group install rolls back on failure.

structs.text: Directory records hold inode, offset, length and flexible name; packed forms tag type in last byte.
Poll pages chain with cursor over flex area; chunks link successors; select holds request and result maps.
Signalfd context holds selected mask; pipe tables mix confirm, release, get and steal variants.
Device record holds device, superblock, pin count and hash linkage; table is resizable device hash.
Sysfs tables encode permission variants per kind; timer holds dual timer, ticks and linkage; mount has ops.
